Before I say anything, let me make it clear: I am not part of Greater Than Games, and this post is entirely speculation.

 

I'm betting they're pretty busy with Sentinel Tactics right now; I'm guessing that they've begun preparing them to ship, as the Kickstarter for that said that the ship to addresses would be finalized a few hours ago.

 

Also for further stretch goals, as much as I'd love to see such, I really doubt it. Assuming we hit all stretch goals, there will be three mini-expansions; judging by the mini-expansions that are already out, once they're available for purchase seperately, the environment will probably be 4 USD, and the hero and villain will probably be 5 USD each. This means that if they hit the 1.5k mark, they'll essentially be giving away 14 USD worth of stuff (not counting the promo cards and art prints) for each 20 USD purchase… That's already some pretty strong incentive right now.

I see your point, and agree with you, but the stretch goals were pretty insane for the Shattered Timelines and Sentinel Tactics Kickstarters.  They wouldn't be doing things that way if it was hurting the company.

The more units they print, up to a point, reduces their total cost per unit, opening up their profit margins for additional stretch goals.  This isn't counting the number of units they'll move of the expansion and associated mini-expansions at general retail, which won't include the cost of the art prints.

Make no mistake, I am 300% happy with what they're currently offering.  I'm so excited about more SotM, but the early launch of Sentinel Tactics will tide me over until it lands on my doorstep.  I just like wild speculation.

Besides, Chrono-Ranger, Omnitron-X, Parse, The Scholar, The Naturalist, The Sentinels, and K.N.Y.F.E. don't have any promos, and we don't want anyone to feel left out, do we?  Not to mention, I would squeal with delight if Citizen Dawn got a promo.
